Speaker 8.name: Whitney Skillen
Speaker 8.role: Claremont School Board member; policy subcommittee chair - MEDIUM CONFIDENCE, reached by elimination plus board-only actions. She answers every roll call, and this cluster performs things only a seated member can do: it seconds the motion appointing the clerk (292), votes 'Aye' (301), asks a substantive 504-versus-IEP question (259), supplies 'Finance' when the business administrator forgets the subcommittee's name (315) and argues the deliberative-session date (374, 377). She is the only member present who has no other cluster. The cluster demonstrably also carries incoming clerk Noelle Kronberg and business administrator Mary Henry; those segments are reassigned by override. Nobody speaks her name in this recording
